integrity: Exact finite-domain verification and a combinatorial nerve proof are included; the result has not been independently audited or externally validated.
scientific_limitations: Determines only the rational automorphism representation for the three-cube perfect-matching complex, not an integral representation lattice or equivariant homotopy splitting. The underlying four-circle homotopy type is prior work [Agarwal--Basak, arXiv:2608.30601v2, Theorem 25]. Unindexed equivariant calculations remain an originality risk.
title: The full cube-symmetry character of perfect-matching homology
